title: Clip review command v1
description: POST /api/v1/clips/{clipId}/review body (staff only). One atomic command: appends a review revision and, for an approval, applies the optional desired dataset membership set in the same database transaction. reviewId is the idempotency key (identical replay returns the stored review, a changed body with the same reviewId conflicts). decision 'rejected' also serves as a withdrawal of an earlier approval: it removes every working dataset membership. Omitting datasetSelection on an approval preserves existing memberships; an explicit empty datasetIds clears them all. expectedRevisions must hold the current revision of every dataset the change touches (the desired set plus the clip's current memberships). Customers have no review route.
